verdict.rationale: Search APIs with AI answer endpoints can plausibly offer user-defined schema output, so this axis applies. The evidence pack never documents passing a custom JSON schema or getting schema-conforming output. The OpenAI-compatible Answers endpoint, pre-extracted LLM context and fixed-format endpoint responses are related features, not schema-defined structured output.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get structured output matching a JSON schema I define
